```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
```

The benchmark pipeline (`make benchmark`, `workflow/Snakefile`, `config/config.yaml`) prepares each dataset once, fits every method to it, and scores how well each method ranks the proteins with a known change (E. coli spiked into a human background in IonStar, UPS1 spiked into yeast in CPTAC) above the unchanged ones. This vignette reads only the tables the pipeline exports to `inst/extdata`.

- Scores: AUC, partial AUC up to a false positive rate of 0.1 (pAUC_10) on a 0–100 scale, all contrasts pooled, for the rankings by fold change (`log_fc`), t statistic (`t_statistic`) and p-value with the sign of the fold change (`scaled.p_value`)
- Level: `protein` (model fitted to protein abundances), `peptide` (model fitted to peptides, one result per protein), `protein + peptide` (hurdle: intensity on proteins, detection on peptides)
- FDP vs FDR: the false discovery proportion at each nominal FDR; on the diagonal the FDR is calibrated

```{r read}
extdata <- function(name) {
  utils::read.delim(file.path("../inst/extdata", name), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = c(tool_version = "character"))
}
scores <- extdata("benchmark_scores.tsv")
curves <- utils::read.delim("../inst/extdata/benchmark_curves.tsv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
methods <- extdata("benchmark_methods.tsv")
datasets <- utils::read.delim("../inst/extdata/benchmark_datasets.tsv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

# Methods

```{r methods}
methods |>
  dplyr::select(dataset, method, tool_version, level, input, description, fit_seconds) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dataset, method) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Fitted methods; fit_seconds: wall time of the fit job (jobs ran in parallel).")
```

```{r datasets, results = "asis", fig.height = 4.5}
for (dataset_name in datasets$dataset) {
  cat("\n\n# ", dataset_name, "\n\n", datasets$description[datasets$dataset == dataset_name], "\n\n", sep = "")
  scores |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$dataset == dataset_name, .data$contrast == "all") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c("AUC", "pAUC_10"), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
    tidyr::unite("column", "metric", "score", sep = " / ") |>
    dplyr::select(model = "model_name", "level", "column", "value") |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "column", values_from = "value", names_sort = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$`pAUC_10 / scaled.p_value`)) |>
    knitr::kable(digits = 1, format = "html", table.attr = "class=\"table table-condensed\"",
                 caption = paste0(dataset_name, ": all contrasts pooled, sorted by pAUC_10 of scaled.p_value.")) |>
    cat()
  dataset_curves <- dplyr::filter(curves, .data$dataset == dataset_name)
  print(
    ggplot2::ggplot(dplyr::filter(dataset_curves, .data$curve == "ROC"),
                    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, colour = method)) +
      ggplot2::geom_step() +
      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.2)) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~score) +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "false positive rate", y = "true positive rate", title = paste(dataset_name, "ROC")) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw()
  )
  print(
    ggplot2::ggplot(dplyr::filter(dataset_curves, .data$curve == "FDP"),
                    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, colour = method)) +
      ggplot2::geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
      ggplot2::geom_step() +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "nominal FDR", y = "false discovery proportion", title = paste(dataset_name, "FDP vs FDR")) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw()
  )
}
```
